content: Tokyo offers an incredible blend of ancient temples and cutting-edge technology. A typical two-week itinerary might include exploring the historic districts of Asakusa and Harajuku, visiting contemporary art museums, enjoying world-class cuisine from street food to Michelin-starred restaurants, and taking day trips to nearby Mount Fuji or the historic temples of Kyoto.
